metadata.case_name: CHUNG HOI KIN v. CHOI SHUN YIN AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: packing worker at Tai Hing Catering Group (part-time since 10 December 2012); undergoing training as a transponder operator at Terminal 9 of the Tsing Yi Container Terminal since around 15 August 2013
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: transponder operator at Tsing Yi Container Terminal

injuries.description: 50% cut of the peroneus longus muscle of the right leg
source: the operation involved 50% cut of the peroneus longus and gastrocnemius muscles of the right leg.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple muscles, fasciae or tendons at lower leg level

injuries.description: 50% cut of the gastrocnemius muscle of the right leg
source: the operation involved 50% cut of the peroneus longus and gastrocnemius muscles of the right leg.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple muscles, fasciae or tendons at lower leg level

injuries.description: Laceration of the right sural nerve with tissue loss beyond repair
source: At the same time, the right sural nerve was found to be lacerated with tissue loss which was found to be beyond repair.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of cutaneous sensory nerve at ankle or foot level

injuries.description: 10 cm laceration over the postero-lateral side of his right leg
source: the plaintiff sustained a 10 cm laceration over the postero-lateral side of his right leg.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of lower leg

manifestations.description: residual weakness over his right leg
episodic feeling of imbalance while walking on level ground
on and off right leg pain on rising up from continuous sitting for half an hour
right leg soreness after prolonged walking for 45 minutes
spontaneous pain over the scar sometimes causing transient muscle cramps
right leg pain after running or after strenuous activities
tightness in the posterior right leg when stretches his leg with knee extended
weakness in ankle when performing ankle movement with toes pointing downwards and upwards
numbness felt over a localized area in the right leg beneath the oblique scar
1.5 cm decrease in the circumference of the right thigh and leg indicating noticeable muscle wastage on the right thigh
low self-esteem and self-image due to his reduced work capacity
irritable mood; depression and anxiety; cannot control his temper (complained but not verified by independent medical evidence)

treatments_received.treatment: Emergency operation with repair of torn muscles
source: an emergency operation was carried out. The operation involved 50% cut of the peroneus longus and gastrocnemius muscles of the right leg. At the same time, the right sural nerve was found to be lacerated with tissue loss which was found to be beyond repair. Repair of the torn muscles was done during the operation.

treatments_received.treatment: Right ankle orthosis for protection of muscle repair
source: The plaintiff was given a right ankle orthosis for the protection of muscle repair.

treatments_received.treatment: Short leg splint (worn for about 2 to 3 months)
source: He was discharged on 21 September 2010 with short leg splint. This splint was worn for about 2 to 3 months.

treatments_received.treatment: Use of 2 crutches for walking until end of December 2010
source: After removed of the splint, the plaintiff used 2 crutches for walking until end of December 2010, ie some 2½ months after the accident.

treatments_received.treatment: Follow up treatment at the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of PMH until 20 April 2011
source: After discharged from the hospital, the plaintiff also received follow up treatment at the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of PMH until 20 April 2011.

treatments_received.treatment: 10 sessions of physiotherapy at the out-patient clinic at PMH (magnetopause therapy, ultrasound therapy, ankle mobilizing and strengthening exercise and walking exercise)
source: The plaintiff received 10 sessions of physiotherapy at the out-patient clinic at PMH from 11 April 2010 to 12 January 2011. Treatment given included magnetopause therapy, ultrasound therapy, ankle mobilizing and strengthening exercise and walking exercise.

treatments_received.treatment: Referral to the occupational therapy out-patient service at PMH for work capacity evaluation
source: He was also referred to the occupational therapy out-patient service at the PMH for work capacity evaluation. He was assessed to be below his previous job demand with significant degree of limitation due to the residual symptoms and his reduced physical ability.
The plaintiff was unable to attend the work rehabilitation programme offered by the Occupational Service Department of PMH due to receiving detoxification treatment for ketamine abuse.

treatments_future.treatment: Further course of physiotherapy (15 to 20 sessions, private sector)
source: 15 to 20 sessions of treatment are suggested by Dr Chiang and each session of treatment in the private sector is estimated to cost around HK$500. The plaintiff’s claims a total HK$11,000 for such further medical treatment and travelling expenses.

losses.description: Residual weakness and numbness over his right leg; decrease in muscle bulk of the right thigh and calf; some reduction in endurance for continuous and prolonged heavy manual work activities
Reduced endurance for prolonged walking and standing; difficulty with prolonged heavy manual activities
Irritable mood, depression and anxiety, cannot control his temper, low self-esteem and self-image due to his reduced work capacity
